note: Exceptions to npm audit --audit-level=high for apps/desktop. Every entry needs a GitHub advisory id, the package it applies to, an expiry (YYYY-MM-DD), and a reason. The SAST job rejects the allowlist after expiry and still fails on every other high or critical advisory.

advisories.reason: picomatch <=4.0.7 (latest release) has no patched version. Vite 6, fdir, and tinyglobby use it only to compile developer-authored or hard-coded globs while building the desktop shell. The ReDoS needs an attacker-controlled extglob pattern; vault data and request paths are match subjects, not patterns, and picomatch is not part of the production Tauri bundle. Drop this entry when a picomatch release above 4.0.7 is available and the lockfile is updated to it.
